description:
Map a concept to the tag names that exist, by spelling and by meaning. Free; use it before filtering by tags.

When to use: the user names a theme or a kind of person ("melancholy", "French poets", "scientists")
and you need exact tag names for quotes_about(tags=[...]) or originators(tags=[...]). Exact tags
filter far more precisely than free-text search.

Returns tags grouped by vocabulary with usage counts, match type (lexical/semantic), score, umbrella
parents and top children. Never returns quotes or people; follow up with:
- quote_topic -> quotes_about(tags=[text])
- originator_category -> originators(tags=[text])
- source_genre -> genre names for context (sources has no genre filter)

Examples:
- `tags_like(concept="melancholy")` - sorrow, sadness, grief topic tags
- `tags_like(concept="French poets", kind="originator_category")` - people categories
- `tags_like(concept="scientists")` - Scientists umbrella plus physicists, chemists, ...

concept.description: Word or phrase to map to tags (e.g., 'melancholy', 'French poets')

kind.description: Limit to one vocabulary: quote_topic (quote tags), originator_category (people categories), source_genre (book/source genres). Omit to search all three.

name: tags_like
title: Find tags by concept
